regime_evidence.market_move: BTC crossed $85,000 for the first time since January while ETH, SOL, SUI, BNB, HYPE and other risk assets rallied simultaneously.
regime_evidence.forced_flow: Reported 24h crypto liquidations exceeded $756M, with roughly $650M from shorts; this makes forced covering a material component of the move and disqualifies price acceleration alone as discretionary-capital confirmation.
regime_evidence.btc_fund_flow: U.S. spot BTC ETFs received about $433M on Sep. 18 and about $593M over Sep. 17-18, but the full Sep. 14-18 week was only about +$6.2M net after prior outflows. This is a genuine institutional-flow leg but not yet persistent enough to explain the entire breakout as fresh discretionary capital.
regime_evidence.eth_fund_flow: U.S. spot ETH ETFs were about -$140M net for the Sep. 14-18 week despite a positive Sep. 18 session, so the ETH rally is not confirmed by weekly ETF capital.
regime_evidence.onchain_context: Previously sampled chain data remains mixed rather than uniformly risk-on: Hyperliquid has the clearest retained-capital + trading continuation, while Solana and Ethereum retained-capital metrics are less convincing and several chains show spot/perp divergence.

clean_components: regulatory optimism around the SEC tokenized-securities exemption
contaminating_components: systematic momentum after BTC broke resistance
broad beta repricing rather than ecosystem-specific retained capital
why_capital_is_arriving.classification: MIXED: real discretionary/institutional demand exists, but the marginal acceleration is materially short-squeeze driven. Do not promote the rally itself to an ecosystem migration signal.

notes: No non-core position exceeds the 7.5% default cap at the contemporaneous marks.

HYPE made a new all-time high with strong token turnover and remains the strongest continuation ecosystem, but no fresh independent selective-wallet confirmation was verified; the Oct. 6 contributor unlock and low circulating/FDV ratio remain material caveats, so no scale add.
ETH is supported by a large BTC-to-ETH staking rotation already recorded earlier, but weekly ETH ETF outflows conflict with treating today's rally as independent institutional confirmation.
SUI's sharp price move is not matched by comparably strong retained-capital inflow, so no add based on price alone.

ZEC remains above the previously identified liquidation-risk zone and its large Garrett Jin hedge has been closed while spot remains held; no new structural failure or distribution trigger was verified.

approx_portfolio_mark.note: Approximate contemporaneous mark only; no ledger/state mutation because no paper trade occurred.

structural_gate.existing_positions: No newly discovered hard structural failure in an existing paper position.

forward_tests: Require post-squeeze persistence after liquidation pressure subsides; if prices/DEX usage retreat as forced covering ends, classify this as a transient squeeze rather than a regime shift.
For BTC/ETH institutional confirmation, require consecutive completed ETF sessions or a clearly positive weekly total rather than one late-week reversal.
For ecosystem-specific adds, require retained stablecoin/bridge capital, spot DEX/user persistence, and independent selective-wallet accumulation rather than broad beta price appreciation.
For HYPE scale-up, require a genuinely independent confirmation leg and reassess dilution/unlock risk before approaching the 7.5% non-core cap.
